name: Carousel
one_line: Items drifting through the frame in a continuous lateral scroll or marquee, often looping
summary: A row or strip of items passes across the frame without stopping, so quantity and range read as ongoing rather than counted. It gives steady momentum under other content and suits logos, products or images in a set. Wrong spacing or speed makes it judder, and a loop that jumps at its seam breaks the illusion.

routes.one_line: Strip redrawn each frame as a pure function of t, wrapped for a seamless loop

steps.does: Draw the repeating items at an offset computed from t, wrapping at the strip length

limits: Suits supplied raster stills; Canvas 2D evidence excludes images and devicePixelRatio above 1
Fractional offsets resample images; sharpness at sub-pixel positions is not evidenced
Evidence covers one font and one machine; wrapped text strips are untested

routes.one_line: Items in one vector strip translated on a seekable timeline, looping by duplication

steps.does: Author the item strip as vector art, repeated so the loop has no gap
Translate the strip along one timeline, seeked per frame

limits: Suits drawn vectors; embedded stills are untested for SVG here
Anime.js evidence is transform, SVG draw and stagger; long looping translation is untested
SVG evidence is a static raster by resvg; browser rendering of a long strip was not exercised

routes.one_line: Many supplied stills as sprites scrolled on the GPU, recycled at the edges

steps.does: Position sprites along the strip from t and recycle those leaving the frame

limits: Suits supplied raster stills; PixiJS evidence is Graphics geometry, not sprites or textures
Throughput with many sprites is outside the evidence scope
Edge recycling must be driven from t, not the ticker, to stay seek-safe

source: references/motion-director §5, §6; references/image-direction §5.1; tool records as of 2026-11-20
